_note: Verbatim records from the 2026-07-07 broken live store (caches/component-store-backup-20260707-healbug) — the maintainer install whose seed refresh was inert (#2514). The 48 components + 2 kits are the pre-#2456 packaged roster, builtin+seedHash-stamped; every stamp matches its record content under the app hasher. Test fixture for the heal assertions in seedRoundTrip.test.ts.
